other_conditions: Must have occupied the position of Professor/Principal Scientist or equivalent for at least 8 years
Must have a minimum age of 0 (no lower age limit specified)
Must have significant contributions evidenced by publications, patents, released varieties/breeds, etc.
Nomination must be supported and recommended by the sponsoring Agricultural University/ICAR Research Institute
The sponsoring institution must agree to the service conditions and provide necessary facilities
Only one position can be held at a time and the appointment cannot extend beyond 65 years of age
benefits_summary: Monthly salary of Rs. 75,000 (fixed) plus admissible allowances.
documents_required: NOC form (if the applicant is in‑service)
